name: qa_pr_view
description: Fetch PR metadata with CI-related fields stripped. Returns title, body, additions, deletions, files, labels, state, branch info, and author. Does NOT return CI check status, merge status, or commit-level check data.

pr_url.description: Full PR URL (e.g., https://github.com/senara-solutions/mika/pull/495) or owner/repo#number format
